title: Egyptian Charcoal-Glazed Broccoli Tagine
description: A charred and flavorful Egyptian-inspired dish with Chinese broccoli and a rich, sticky glaze.

ingredients.name: broccoli florets
ingredients.notes: Chinese broccoli, also known as gai lan

instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and prepare a charcoal glaze by mixing together honey, apple cider vinegar, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
In a large mason jar, combine broccoli florets, olive oil, garlic cloves, ginger, and lemon juice. Toss to coat.
Cover the mason jar with a lid and bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.
Remove the mason jar from the oven and brush the charcoal glaze evenly over the broccoli florets.
Return the mason jar to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the broccoli is tender and the glaze is caramelized.
Remove the mason jar from the oven and let it cool slightly.
